$comment: Contributor credits. Recognition is manual and opt-in: a person is added here only after they ask to be listed, and never automatically from git history. Every field except 'name' is optional.
howToBeCredited: Open a pull request that adds your entry, or say so in the pull request that contains your contribution. Use a handle rather than a real name if you prefer. Include a link only to a profile you are happy to publish.
